fonts.display: 'PP Mori', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Editorial New', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary text, nav text, dark footer surface, filled button background, badge fills — near-black with a barely-perceptible cool tint reads as warmer than pure #000 in print contexts

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills, inverted button text — the dominant ground

palette.name: Soft Ash
palette.role: Muted borders, image placeholder backgrounds, secondary dividers

palette.name: Stone Gray
palette.role: List dividers, body-level borders, tertiary structural lines

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Helper text, de-emphasized body copy, subtle metadata

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Link text and link borders in body context — slight lift from pure ink

palette.name: True Black
palette.role: Hard border accent in lists and structural dividers where maximum contrast is needed

palette.name: Night Forest
palette.role: Navigation-specific borders and text — a cool desaturated charcoal distinct from the warm Ink Black

palette.name: Highlighter Yellow
palette.role: Yellow wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color
